We are choosing storage for a local-first creative asset catalog shared by several worker processes. A teammate proposes SQLite WAL because it supposedly permits many simultaneous writers and says copying catalog.db while workers are active is sufficient for backup. Use the fixed primary-source evidence packet in sources.md to assess these two claims. Produce decision.md with a concrete architecture and backup recommendation, citations to the source URLs, and a clear separation between documented behavior and your design inference. Also assess a shared NFS home deployment and identify an unresolved question that would need project measurements. Keep the recommendation under 700 words. The provided packet is the complete research scope for this controlled exercise; no live browsing is needed. Do not implement the catalog.
